control: SINUMERIK 840D sl / 828D in ISO Dialect Milling mode (G291)

sources.title: SINUMERIK 802D sl/840D/840D sl/840Di/840Di sl/810D Programming Manual ISO Milling (PGM)
sources.edition: 04.2007, 6FC5398-7BP10-0BA0; valid for 840D sl/DE sl SW 1.4 (828D not in validity list)

native_language_and_iso_mode.value: Native = Siemens G-code mode (G290, default on boot). ISO Dialect mode selected with G291, programmed alone in its own block; G290 returns to Siemens mode. Machine data can make the control boot directly in ISO Dialect mode. ISO and Siemens code cannot be mixed in one block; Siemens functions other than subprogram calls need a switch to G290 first. Active tool, tool offsets and zero offsets are unchanged by the switch.

program_open.value: G291 (own block) as first block of an ISO program unless the machine boots in ISO mode; then e.g. G21 in its own block at the beginning (manual example: 'G291;' then 'G20;').
program_open.note: No O-number / '%' program header is described for ISO mode in S1. File-transfer naming (%_N_NAME_MPF) is from Siemens native docs, see siemens-native.json.

program_close.value: M30 (end of tape: NC reset) or M02 (end of program: NC reset); behavior after end is machine-builder defined. M99 = end of subprogram, M98 = subprogram call.

comment.value: Both: round brackets ( ) are the ISO-mode comment; ';' to end of line is also accepted in ISO mode. Nested '(' must all be closed before the comment ends.

line_numbers.value: N word allowed (manual examples: N5, N01, N0120, N3000). Required? not stated. Maximum: not stated in S1.
line_numbers.note: max N value UNKNOWN for ISO mode; native-mode block rules (S2 p. 37) say N + positive integer, block max 512 chars.

block_end.value: Newline (LF). Manual shows ';' at end of ISO example blocks, but in this control ';' starts a comment, so a trailing ';' is harmless (treated as empty comment).
block_end.where: 1.1.7 p. 1-15 (';' = comment); S2 2.2.2 p. 37 (block ends with LF)
block_end.note: LF rule from S2 (native manual); S1 does not separately define block end.

safe_start.value: G291 (own block, mode switch); G21 (metric, own block at program start); G90; G94; G17 (power-on default); G40; G49 (or H00); G80.
safe_start.note: G71/G70 are NOT the metric/inch codes in ISO mode (G20/G21 are); G70/G71 are native Siemens.

tool_change.value: T function format is machine-builder defined (S1 3.6.2 refers to MTB). Manual example uses 'T11 M6' in one block. M6 may also be mapped to a macro via $MN_EXTERN_M_NO_MAC_CYCLE.
tool_change.note: D word in ISO mode is the radius-offset number; H is the length-offset number (mapped to Siemens T/D via $TC_DPH).

tool_length_comp.value: G43 Z.. H.. (add) / G44 (subtract) / G49 or H00 cancel; modal, group 08; only allowed in G00/G01 mode.

spindle.value: S up to 5 digits, rpm; M03 CW, M04 CCW, M05 stop (M03<->M04 needs M05 between, generally).

work_offset.value: G54..G59, plus G54 P1..P100 (extended); power-on default G54; G92 set; G52 local; G53 machine coords (one-shot).
work_offset.note: p. 3-46 says G54 P{1...93} for the frame-mapping variant; range depends on version/MD.

arc_format.value: G17 G02/G03 X Y with I J (signed distance start->center, i.e. incremental) or R (radius). G18: K I; G19: J K. End point per G90/G91. Helical: add 3rd axis.

rapid_linear.value: G00 rapid positioning (axes may move independently, non-straight path unless MD EXTERN_G0_LINEAR_MODE); G01 linear at F.

feed_word.value: F in mm/min under G94 (6-digit); G95 per rev; G93 inverse time. F0 gives an alarm (or rapid if F1-digit feed active); negative F not allowed.

decimal_point.value: Machine-data dependent (MD 10884): 'pocket calculator' notation -> X1000 = 1000 mm; 'standard' notation -> value without point times increment: IS-B X1000 = 1 mm, IS-C X1000 = 0.1 mm. With a decimal point the value is always mm. Applies to X Y Z U V W A B C I J K Q R F.
decimal_point.note: Post should always write a decimal point on these addresses in ISO mode.

max_digits.value: F: 6 digits; S: 5 digits; M: up to 3 digits, up to 5 M codes per block. IS-B resolution 0.001 mm, IS-C 0.0001 mm; G04 X range IS-B 0.001..99999.999.

retract_home.value: G28 X.. Y.. Z.. (via intermediate point to reference point; manual uses 'G28 G91 X0 Y0 Z0'); or G53 X.. Y.. Z.. (machine coordinates, one-shot, absolute only).

coolant_flood.value: M08 coolant ON (listed as general M code; function defined by machine builder).

coolant_mist.note: Not listed in S1. Memory says M07 commonly, unverified.

coolant_through_spindle.note: Not in S1; machine-builder M code.

coolant_off.value: M09 coolant OFF (general M code, MTB defined).

dwell.value: G04 X_ (seconds, decimal allowed) or G04 P_ (no decimal, units of 0.001 s) in G94 mode; in G95 mode unit is spindle revolutions. Block must contain only G04.

drill_G81.value: G81 X.. Y.. Z.. R.. F.. K..; Z = hole bottom, R = R level, K = repeats; modal until G80/G00-G03.

dwell_drill_G82.value: G82 X.. Y.. Z.. R.. P.. F.. K..; P = dwell at bottom (example P1000 = 1 s).

peck_G83.value: G83 X.. Y.. Z.. R.. Q.. F.. K..; Q = depth per peck, incremental, no sign; retract to R each peck; re-approach distance d from GUD _ZSFR[10].

chip_break_G73.value: G73 X.. Y.. Z.. R.. Q.. F.. K..; retract amount d from GUD _ZSFR[1] (0 means 1 mm).

rigid_tap_G84.value: G84 X.. Y.. Z.. R.. P.. F.. K..; under G94 F = feed mm/min (lead = F/S); under G95 F = lead mm/rev. P = dwell at bottom and at R. MD $MC_EXTERN_FUNCTION_MASK bit 8 = 1 makes F the thread pitch. Left-hand: G74. Rigid vs floating chosen by GUD _ZSFI[1].

bore_ream_G85.value: G85 X.. Y.. R.. F.. K.. (Z = bottom); feed in and feed out.

return_level_G98_G99.value: G98 return to initial level (usual power-on default); G99 return to R level; modal.

cycle_cancel_G80.value: G80 cancels canned cycle and clears R/Z and all cycle addresses; G00-G03 also cancel.

cycle_dwell_units.value: P in milliseconds (example G82 ... P1000 = dwell 1 s).
cycle_dwell_units.note: Units inferred from the worked example; P for G04 is stated as 0.001 s units (p. 3-67).

notes: ISO canned cycles are implemented as shell cycles that call standard Siemens cycles; cycle parameters live in GUD7 (_ZFPR/_ZSFR/_ZSFI) set by the machine builder. 'Tool offsets are ignored in the canned cycle mode' is stated for each cycle while p. 4-95 says tool length comp must be selected before the cycle; read as length comp applied at R positioning (p. 4-119). Only a 2007 English ISO Milling manual was found openly on Siemens hosts; 2009/2012/2019 editions seen only as third-party copies (Scribd/manualmachine), not used.
